chunks: We shall invest whosoever works for good, whether man or woman, with a pleasant life, and reward them in accordance with the best of what they have done.

key_terms.أَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ: the best of what they used to do

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for righteous believers in this life and the next according to Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the spiritual equality of men and women, highlighting that faith and righteous action are the sole criteria for divine reward. The 'pleasant life' (Hayatun Tayyibah) is interpreted not only as a future promise but as a state of inner peace and spiritual clarity attainable in this world through consistent devotion.
